caseSpec.en:
40mm stainless steel case with satin-brushed and polished finishes
Open case back with domed sapphire crystal

movementSpec.en:
Manufacture Calibre MT5652-U (COSC and METAS certified)
Self-winding mechanical movement with bidirectional rotor system
Integrated GMT function

windingCrownSpec.en: Stainless steel screw-down cone-shaped winding crown with the TUDOR shield in relief

bezelSpec.en: Fixed stainless steel bezel with satin-brushed and polished finishes

dialSpec.en:
Black dial with 24-hour graduated rehaut
Date at 3 o'clock
"Northflag" hands and hour markers with Swiss Super-LumiNova® luminescent material

braceletSpec.en: 2-link integrated bracelet in stainless steel, satin-brushed and polished finishes, with TUDOR "T-fit" rapid adjustment clasp

title.en: METAS Master Chronometer certification is comprehensive and covers the main functional characteristics of a watch including precision, resistance to magnetic fields, waterproofness and power reserve. Its standards are incredibly high, starting with precision.

swiss-made.en: Two prerequisites are necessary for obtaining the certification: Swiss manufacturing must conform to Swiss Made criteria, and the movement must be certified by the Official Swiss Chronometer Testing Institute (COSC).

precision.en:
Certification by the Swiss Official Chronometer Testing Institute (COSC)
Precision at two temperatures, in six different positions and at two different levels of power reserve: 100% and 33%

waterproofness.en: Waterproof to 100m (330 ft) in accordance with ISO standard

anti-magnetism.en: Smooth functioning when exposed to a magnetic field of 15,000 gauss and precision following exposure
